title: Fyninu Community Server Pack
description: A custom modpack for the Twitch Streamer Fyninu's Community Server.
body:
## About
---
This Modpack optimises the game and add a voicechat to talk with other players. It gives you options like seeing how much hunger an item adds, recipes for all items, a better and more informative F3 menu, Shader support and reworked audio all ontop of making the game more optimised. _It essentially makes the game look better and work faster while making it use less power!_

_The Modpack was made for the community of the twitch streamer Fyninu's Supporter server._



## Known Issues:
---
![REI error](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ccc378e6db3231d5cf6a24e6013350ee9ac67165.png)![Partial Recipe Data REI error](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c39198de2ec2fee318ca0fdf5fb71bd6cce66017.png)

- REI will give you this error when playing on a server that doesn't have REI installed. This is because of a change in how minecraft sends users recipe info. ~~You can **savely dismiss/Ignore** this error as it is not possible to fix.~~ **This causes REI to not work with no fix in sight!**
- Same issue exists for Jade so it will __work__ but not with all functionality. The visible chest content feature of Jade **won't work** and will **always say empty** because of this!
  
  
- Another known issue is that the game looks like it freezes when quitting from servers/worlds to the menu. I haven't found the reason for this and thus cannot fix it.
